description: Estimated annual generation (GWh) and capacity factor of solar projects in the Saudi tracker, the GCC tracker and the Saudi captive segment, modelled with PVGIS (EU JRC) at the town or region centroid — never the plant — for a fixed array at the optimal tilt and for a single-axis tracker, with totals by tracker and stage. Pass `project` (a tracker id such as sudair-pv-1500-mw) for one project, or filter by tracker, stage and country. The list of projects is a layer of the Energy Atlas and is free with membership: it needs a member’s API key; one project by `project` answers anyone. Modelled, not measured: quote it as an estimate.
name: project_output_estimate
title: Estimated output of solar projects (PVGIS model)
